description: Update fields on an existing record identified by its sys_id.

apply.description: true executes; omitted: a non-mutating plan preview (SN_WRITE_MODE=apply executes by default).

expected_mod_count.description: sys_mod_count from the plan's apply_with; with apply, a changed record is refused (STALE_RECORD).

inputDisplayValue.description: Values are display values the instance resolves (sysparm_input_display_value); default false: raw.

update_set.description: Update set (sys_id or exact name, in progress) to record the write in; switched for it, then restored. Default SN_UPDATE_SET, else unchanged. Data-row tables are not captured.

name: servicenow_update_record
title: Update ServiceNow record
